0022600208.text: The Rockets host the Nuggets in Houston's 11th game of the 2026-27 season, as Houston (7-3, 4-1 at home) sits 1 game back in 2nd place in the Southwest and 6th in the West after losing its last two. Denver (5-3) enters on a two-game winning streak, 2 games back in 4th place in the Northwest and 9th in the West, and is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain). This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, following a 2025-26 season series in which the Rockets lost 1-3, including a 129-93 loss in Denver on March 11, 2026.
